value.rationale: Uniform-element order statistics for Sylow subgroups are natural. The sharp all-fixed-defects factorial layers quantify exponentially rare almost-maximal-order elements beyond the classical typical speed and bounded variance results. The result has nontrivial uniform mathematical content over unbounded group depth and every prime; a finite exact recurrence alone is not asserted as valuable novelty.
